verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents import tooling, backups, MCP/AI agent integrations, and standard MySQL/Postgres compatibility, but no first-party feature for bulk-exporting all data plus schema in an open, portable format for a full account exit. A community comment even explicitly states PlanetScale is not open source and represents 'vendor lock-in,' reinforcing the absence of a documented open-export/leave path rather than contradicting an actual vendor claim.
